title_en: Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Opinion on Carrying out the Thematic Practice Activity of "People's Judges for the People"
full_text_en:
Notice of the Supreme People's Court on Issuing the Opinions on Carrying Out the Thematic Practice Activity of "People's Judges for the People"

Fa Fa [2009] No. 25

To: High people's courts of all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government; the Military Court of the People's Liberation Army; the Production and Construction Corps Branch of the High People's Court of Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region

The Supreme People's Court hereby issues to you the Opinions on Carrying Out the Thematic Practice Activity of "People's Judges for the People" for your earnest implementation.

May 4, 2009

Opinions on Carrying Out the Thematic Practice Activity of "People's Judges for the People"

In order to thoroughly study and implement the spirit of the Seventeenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the important directives of General Secretary Hu Jintao on the work of the people's courts in the new era, to continuously consolidate the achievements of in-depth study and practice of the Scientific Outlook on Development and the educational activities on the socialist rule of law concept, to continuously strengthen the guiding ideology of the "Three Supremes," to closely focus on the work theme of "serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people," to earnestly implement the work policy of "governing the court strictly, establishing credibility in the court, and strengthening the court with science and technology," and to comprehensively strengthen the construction of the court contingent, the Supreme People's Court has decided: all courts at all levels throughout the country shall extensively, continuously, and deeply carry out the thematic practice activity of "People's Judges for the People" in the current and future period.

I. Significance of Carrying Out the Thematic Practice Activity

In recent years, under the leadership of the Party, people's courts at all levels have earnestly fulfilled the duties conferred by the Constitution and laws. While satisfactorily completing the increasingly heavy and arduous tasks of adjudication and execution, they have continuously strengthened their own contingent construction, achieving new developments in the work of the people's courts. The vast majority of court personnel have earnestly performed their duties and worked diligently, making outstanding contributions to strengthening the construction of democracy and the rule of law in our country, safeguarding national security and social harmony and stability, and promoting sound and rapid economic and social development. Practice has proven that the national court contingent is a contingent trusted by the Party and the people, full of combat effectiveness and dedication. However, it must also be clearly recognized that there is still a considerable gap between the current state of the court contingent and the new situations and tasks facing them, as well as the new demands and expectations of the people. Some court personnel lack a sense of responsibility and dedication; their abilities and qualities are difficult to meet the needs of work development; problems such as low case-handling quality and low judicial efficiency have not yet been fundamentally resolved; some personnel have weak awareness of serving the people, are frivolous in style, simplistic in methods, and harsh in attitude, seriously hurting the feelings of the people; a very small number of personnel are not honest and impartial in the judiciary, seriously damaging the judicial credibility of the people's courts. To fundamentally change this situation, it is necessary to promptly understand the feelings and expectations of the people, humbly listen to their opinions and suggestions, comprehensively examine the prominent problems and weak links existing in the court contingent, effectively strengthen the construction of the leading bodies, ideological and political construction, judicial capacity building, discipline and work style construction, and anti-corruption and integrity construction of the people's courts, effectively solve the prominent issues that the people strongly reflect, and continuously create new prospects for the work of the people's courts.

The thematic practice activity of "People's Judges for the People" is an important practical carrier for the people's courts to carry out in-depth study and practice of the Scientific Outlook on Development, deepen the education on the guiding ideology of the "Three Supremes" and the socialist rule of law concept, and further carry out the "big study, big discussion" activities. People's courts at all levels must deeply understand the importance of carrying out the thematic practice activity of "People's Judges for the People" and regard the successful implementation of this activity as a good opportunity for the people's courts to improve their capabilities, change their work style, solve problems, and meet challenges. Through carrying out the thematic practice activity, the political and organizational advantages of the socialist judicial system will be transformed into a powerful driving force for promoting the construction of the court contingent and various work, laying a solid ideological, political, and organizational foundation for the people's courts to better serve scientific development and achieve their own scientific development under the new historical conditions.

II. Guiding Ideology and Overall Objectives of Carrying Out the Thematic Practice Activity

The guiding ideology for carrying out the thematic practice activity of "People's Judges for the People" is: hold high the great banner of socialism with Chinese characteristics; take Deng Xiaoping Theory and the important thought of "Three Represents" as the guide; deeply implement the Scientific Outlook on Development; consciously adhere to the "Three Supremes" of the Party's cause, the people's interests, and the Constitution and laws; closely focus on the work theme of "serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people"; earnestly implement the work policy of "governing the court strictly, establishing credibility in the court, and strengthening the court with science and technology"; continuously deepen the construction of leading bodies, ideological and political construction, judicial capacity building, judicial work style construction, anti-corruption and integrity construction, court culture construction, and institutional construction of the people's courts; strive to transform ideological concepts that do not meet the requirements of the people; strive to solve the prominent issues that the people strongly reflect and are concerned about; implement the requirement of "judicature for the people" into the work of adjudication and execution; make the work of the people's courts more in line with people's conditions, reflect public opinion, serve people's livelihood, and win people's hearts; and make the court cadre contingent truly become the builders and defenders of the cause of socialism with Chinese characteristics.

The overall objectives of carrying out the thematic practice activity of "People's Judges for the People" are: deeply implement the spirit of the Seventeenth National Congress of the Communist Party of China and the important directives of General Secretary Hu Jintao on the work of the people's courts in the new era; take ensuring fair and honest judiciary as the core; strengthen ideological education, capacity training, work style cultivation, and institutional innovation; strive to build a court contingent that is politically steadfast, professionally competent, wholeheartedly devoted to the people, fair, honest, and clean; and thereby promote the scientific development of various work of the people's courts.

—— Firmly establish the socialist rule of law concept, adhere to the guiding ideology of the "Three Supremes," and further strengthen the consciousness of "serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people";

—— Strive to practice the concept of judicature for the people, actively implement various measures that are convenient and beneficial to the people, and further enhance the people's satisfaction with the work of the courts;

—— Effectively strengthen the training of judges, transform concepts, and improve capabilities and qualities. Improve and perfect the judicial management mechanism, and further enhance the quality, efficiency, and effectiveness of adjudication and execution work and the judicial credibility of the people's courts;

—— Comprehensively strengthen the construction of anti-corruption and integrity with a fair and honest judiciary as the core, improve and perfect the institutional system for punishing and preventing corruption in the people's courts, and further improve the discipline and work style of the court contingent.

III. Basic Methods of Carrying Out the Thematic Practice Activity

Carrying out the thematic practice activity of "People's Judges for the People" is a comprehensive and long-term task for the people's courts to practice the work theme of "serving the overall situation and administering justice for the people." Courts at all levels should pay attention to organically integrating this activity into the daily work of court business construction and contingent construction, achieving a combination of comprehensive coordination and overall planning, and a combination of short-term arrangements and long-term planning.

After the issuance of these Opinions, the Supreme People's Court will formulate and issue annual implementation plans each year, providing guiding opinions on the key contents of the thematic practice activity for that year. Local courts at all levels may, within the framework of the overall deployment of the Supreme People's Court, arrange the methods, time, and steps for carrying out the activity based on the actual work of their own regions and units. The Supreme People's Court will organize local courts at all levels to inspect and accept the implementation of the activity for that year at the end of each year.

In carrying out the thematic practice activity, courts at all levels should unify thinking and deepen understanding throughout the entire process, identify and solve problems throughout the entire process, and promote reform, innovation, and improvement of systems and mechanisms throughout the entire process. They should adhere to the principle of focusing on whatever problem is prominent and striving to solve it, and strive to solve the prominent issues that the people strongly reflect, ensuring that the vast majority of court personnel receive education, the construction of the contingent is elevated, the work of the courts achieves practical results, and the people gain tangible benefits, allowing the people to truly feel the new changes and new atmosphere brought about by the thematic practice activity to the people's courts.

IV. Basic Requirements for Carrying Out the Thematic Practice Activity

In carrying out the thematic practice activity of "People's Judges for the People," it is necessary to closely integrate it with the adjudication and execution work of the people's courts, closely integrate it with the actual situation of contingent construction in the region and unit, and organically combine it with the various work and educational activities currently being carried out in the region and unit. The following basic requirements must be earnestly grasped:

(1) Highlight practical characteristics. Respect judicial rules, focus on judicial functions, and always place the entry point and landing point of the thematic practice activity on the primary task of handling cases and the fundamental task of contingent construction. The practical characteristics of the activity should be integrated throughout the entire process of the activity to prevent the thematic practice activity from being disconnected from the central work of the people's courts.

(2) Pay attention to overall planning and balance. The thematic practice activity should be organically combined with the study and practice of the Scientific Outlook on Development, education on the socialist rule of law concept, the "big study, big discussion" activities, and various special activities organized by local courts at all levels. They should be considered comprehensively and promoted in parallel to avoid overlapping deployment, redundant arrangements, and mutual disconnection among various activities.

(3) Focus on solving problems. Judicial fairness is the most fundamental requirement of judicature for the people. Ensuring judicial fairness should be regarded as an important content of realizing judicature for the people. In accordance with the requirements of strictness, fairness, efficiency, honesty, and civilization, earnestly solve problems existing in adjudication and execution work, such as unfair judgments, low efficiency, incorrect work style, and poor image.

(4) Adhere to adapting measures to local conditions. Respect the pioneering spirit of grassroots courts, and encourage local courts at all levels to determine their own activity contents and step arrangements based on the actual conditions of their own regions and units, and to solve the weak links in the contingent construction of their own regions and units, as well as the hot and difficult issues in adjudication and execution work.

(5) Adhere to the mass line. Take meeting the people's judicial needs and safeguarding the legitimate rights and interests of the masses as the starting point; take strengthening communication with public opinion, facilitating litigation for the masses, and protecting the litigation rights of parties as the entry point; continuously broaden the channels of judicial democracy; ensure the people's right to know, express, participate, and supervise judicial work; take the demands and expectations of the masses as the key to strengthening and improving work; take the satisfaction of the masses as an important basis for evaluating the effectiveness of work; and do more practical things in adjudication and execution work that conform to public opinion, relieve people's worries, and win people's hearts.

(6) Strengthen positive publicity. Enhance publicity awareness, vigorously promote the main theme of the people's judiciary, strive to do a good job in guiding and responding to public opinion, and strive to enhance understanding, understanding, and support of the work of the people's courts and people's judges from all sectors of society, creating a good social environment for the people's courts to independently and impartially exercise their adjudicative power according to law.

V. Strengthening the Organizational Leadership of the Thematic Practice Activity

Carrying out the thematic practice activity of "People's Judges for the People" is a major event for the construction of the court contingent in the current and future period, and it is also a major event concerning the overall work of the people's courts. Courts at all levels should place this work on an important agenda, attach great importance, carefully organize, and ensure that the activity achieves practical results.

(1) Leadership responsibility must be implemented. The Party groups of courts at all levels shall strengthen leadership over the thematic practice activity. The principal responsible comrades of the Party group shall personally study, personally deploy, and personally supervise, and earnestly fulfill the primary responsibility. The Supreme People's Court has established a leadership group for the thematic practice activity of "People's Judges for the People," and the office of the leadership group is located in the Political Department. Local courts at all levels shall also establish corresponding leading institutions and working institutions.

(2) Supervision and guidance must be strengthened. The Supreme People's Court and all higher and intermediate people's courts shall fully grasp the progress of the activity in lower courts, promptly discover and solve problems. They shall conduct in-depth investigation and research, strengthen graded and categorized guidance, and enhance the pertinence and effectiveness of the activity.

(3) In-depth investigation and research must be conducted. In the process of carrying out the thematic practice activity, courts at all levels should pay attention to going deep into the grassroots and the masses, and extensively listen to the opinions of deputies to people's congresses at all levels, members of the Chinese People's Political Consultative Conference, and the broad masses of the people on court work. At the beginning of each year, local courts at all levels shall report the collected opinions and suggestions level by level to the Supreme People's Court.

(4) Attention must be paid to inspection and evaluation. Each higher people's court shall, in combination with local actual conditions, study and propose the key issues to be urgently solved by local courts, as well as the measures, work requirements, and inspection and acceptance standards. In the inspection and acceptance at the end of the year, attention should be paid to combining the self-evaluation of the people's courts with social evaluation and mass evaluation, adopting appropriate methods to conduct mass satisfaction surveys, and ensuring that the inspection and evaluation conclusions are comprehensive and objective.

(5) Experience must be summarized in a timely manner. Courts at all levels should pay attention to summarizing the good experiences and good practices of carrying out the thematic practice activity. The Supreme People's Court and all higher and intermediate people's courts should frequently organize exchanges and promptly promote them. Attention should be paid to fixing and persisting in good experiences and practices in the form of systems, forming a long-term mechanism, and ensuring that the thematic practice activity continuously achieves new results.
